description: A signature- or merkle-authorized action can be REPLAYED or its authorized fields RE-BOUND because the signed/verified payload omits a nonce, a per-claim consumed-flag, a deadline, the chainId, or a binding of the sensitive fields — letting an attacker re-execute an authorized action or impersonate the signer/claimant. Anchored on Phi 2024-08 H-01 (signatureClaim replay -> unauthorized reward claiming) and H-02 (createArt signature replay -> impersonate artist, steal royalties).

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: show the signed/verified payload lacks a nonce / consumed-flag / deadline / chainId / field binding
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: submit the same signature (or re-bound fields) a second time / from a second context; assert it is accepted (not reverted as replayed)
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: assert the replay/rebind yields unauthorized value or rights (extra reward claim, stolen royalties, impersonated minter) with the victim taking no action

high_severity_rationale: High requires proving the replay/rebind yields unauthorized value or rights (double reward, stolen royalties, impersonation) reachable by the attacker without the victim acting. Medium is proven by an accepted replay/rebind without a quantified value/rights gain. Note chainId binding alone is not sufficient if a nonce/consumed-flag is still missing.
negative_control_template: Add a replay guard: per-signature nonce or a consumed mapping keyed by the signature/leaf hash (and a deadline + chainId + binding of ref_/artId/minter). Assert the second submission of the same signature reverts and re-bound fields are rejected.
